$comment: Single source of truth for every dropdown list, its definitions, and the field list. After editing, run `npm run generate` to update the JSON Schema, issue template, and docs tables.

assistant.label: Other
assistant.definition: Name it in the next field

behavior_type.label: Instruction drift
behavior_type.definition: Ignores, forgets, or gradually drifts from explicit instructions (format, constraints, persona, scope).

behavior_type.label: Fabrication
behavior_type.definition: Invents facts, sources, quotes, citations, actions, or capabilities it doesn't have.

behavior_type.label: Odd refusal / over-caution
behavior_type.definition: Refuses, hedges, or adds warnings in a case that seems clearly benign.

behavior_type.label: Self-contradiction
behavior_type.definition: Contradicts something it said earlier in the same chat, without being prompted.

behavior_type.label: Caving / reversal under pushback
behavior_type.definition: Abandons a correct or previously stated position when the user merely pushes back.

behavior_type.label: Identity / persona / tone
behavior_type.definition: Odd claims about itself, unexpected persona shifts, or tone that doesn't fit the context.

severity.label: Minor
severity.definition: Noticeable but harmless, no effect on outcome.

severity.label: Moderate
severity.definition: Would mislead or waste effort if not caught.

severity.label: Major
severity.definition: Seriously wrong or risky; could cause harm or a wrong decision if trusted.

reproduced.label: Reproduced
reproduced.definition: Happened again when the same or a similar prompt was retried.

reproduced.label: Not reproduced
reproduced.definition: Retried, but the behavior did not happen again.

fields.label: Assistant name (if Other)
fields.help: Required only when Assistant is Other.

fields.label: Model / version
fields.help: As shown in the UI, if visible.
fields.placeholder: e.g., the model name in the picker

fields.label: Task domain
fields.help: What kind of work you were doing.

fields.label: Features on
fields.help: Web search, memory, tools, file uploads, etc.

fields.label: Custom instructions
fields.help: Custom instructions or system prompt used, if any. Redact anything personal.

fields.label: Trigger prompt
fields.help: The prompt that triggered the behavior. Redact personal or confidential details.

fields.label: Behavior type (primary)
fields.help: The main kind of odd behavior.

fields.label: Behavior type (secondary)
fields.help: Optional second type. Must differ from the primary type.

fields.label: Excerpt
fields.help: The odd part of the response, max 1,500 characters. Quote only what is needed.

fields.label: Chat link
fields.help: Shared-chat link, if public. Links to private chats won't work for others, and a shared link can expose the whole conversation.

fields.label: Reproduced
fields.help: Did you retry, and did it happen again?

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else that helps a reader understand the incident.

consent.label: Consent
consent.text: I removed personal and confidential information and agree to release this submission under CC BY 4.0.

privacy_warning: Do not submit personal data, confidential or proprietary material, credentials, or other people's private information. Redact before submitting. Submissions are public.
